Operational delay of the container does not extend the billing clock in this benchmark. All required evidence is held and no evidence is missing; the satisfied gates (billed_party_permitted, charge_period_reconstructable, free_time_applied, dispute_receipt_truthful) are confirmed. Policy SYN-FMC-BILL requires no duplicate party billed for the same charge before an invoice may reach review-ready; that hard gate is not satisfied. All required evidence is held (transportation_contract, invoice_record, container_event_log, free_time_calendar, dispute_receipt) with none missing, and the remaining gates (invoice_within_thirty_days, charge_period_reconstructable, free_time_applied, dispute_receipt_truthful) are satisfied. Because the permitted-billed-party hard gate failed, the bounded action is a payment hold. No notice, deadline, or confidentiality flags are at risk, and no final adjudication is made.
